author: kts
log:
* started on a switch which changes PhysicalAttributes' internal storage format from
Euler/Vector3 to Matrix34 (since ODE uses a matrix as its native format). There are several
issues which need to be resolved, the biggest is we sometimes read the Euler angles back, which
cannot be done reliably from a matrix
*Added a Matrix function which converts the PhysicalAttributes internal representation (whichever
it is) to a Matrix34

*some compartmentalization, for example, PhysicalAttributes no longer has individual functions
to retreive the 3 rotation components, it just has an Euler accessor, which the caller can then
retreive the rotation components from

*removed redundant accesor orientation from PhysicalAttributes (use Rotation instead)

author: kts
log:
*messaging system now passes any array of bytes instead of a long (so that floats and doubles can be passed)
*preliminary work on intergrating ODE, source/physics test program uses our renderer and ODEs physics
*more optimizations turned on for release build

*added support for float/double based Scalars, basically works, except physics occasionally asserts
(this is probably due to differences in rounding compared to fixed point, but I don't care, I just
want to replace it with ODE anyway). A lot of stuff was touched to do this, including channels
(their on disk storage is fixed, but their accessors need to return float (if built for float), also
touched path code, joystick recorder, mailbox interface, .. Many places where integers were being
passing into Scalar constructors without a proper adapter

*standardized common block names and created accessor functions for common block entries (since
a cast or conversion is now requred to make them Scalars)

Removed Angle::AsScalar, it was the same as AsRevolution

added more validation to math classes, added some tests to mathtest
added Scalar::AsText (used by scripting languages)

added std:: to c++ lib references
